page.subtitle: About 3 minutes
page.introLead: I would rather ask you than guess, so I have put the whole list in one place.
page.introAccount: Your answers are saved to your account, so you can change them until the survey closes.

progress.label: Answered
progress.aria: How much of the survey you have answered

field.textPlaceholder: Write as much or as little as you like
field.maxThreeLeft: {left, plural, =0 {Three is the limit. Clear one to pick another.} one {# left} other {# left}}

save.error: That answer did not save. Change it once more and I will retry.

submit.missing: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} still needs an answer.
submit.error: That did not go through. Try again.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: I read every single answer myself, and I will tell you in the forum what came out of it.
thanks.editable: You can change your answers until the survey closes.

closed.title: This survey has closed
closed.body: Thank you to everyone who answered. What came out of it lands on the roadmap.

notFound.title: I cannot find that survey
notFound.body: The link is probably an old one. The roadmap shows what I am working on now.

error.title: The survey did not load
error.body: Nothing was lost. Any answers you have already given are safe.
